liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (2 reviews): Inner play between Jerry and Bobby on Bertha into Greatest Story; Absolute detonation into Bertha, striding the musical landscape as colossal beasts [16][19]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): The Other One is about as good as it gets; Incendiary Other One out of a very cool space [15][17]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Little Red Rooster really comes to life with Matt Kelly [20]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): The Wheel is sweet going into Dead Space and The Other One [11]
- **Drums** (1 review): Drums into Space rules, featuring a small Cumberland Blues tease [11]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Stella Blue is butchered, but Jerry jams extra long to compensate [13]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Set ends with a smokin' Good Lovin' and Brokedown Palace encore [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-12-14.all.sbd.minches.108813.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 195 min; rated 4.5/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Clear, crisp SBD, much better than the available audience recordings; Very good sound, well played, with a laid-back and mellow feel [13][20]
- **gd1980-12-14.175909.nak700.ellner.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 186 min [3]
- **gd1980-12-14.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.89058.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 182 min; rated 4.82/5 by 11 [5]. Said about its sound: Sound is full and deep, with rich bass and crisp highs [9]
- **gd1980-12-14.nak700.miller.89003.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 170 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [7]. Said about its sound: Lacks the really bad noise reduction found in another version [7]

## Around the show

- Flora Purim makes creepy noises during the intense Estimated Prophet jam [13]
- Lesh played a significant role in making the show great [15]
- Airto and Flora performed during drums; 12-song first set [18]
- This recording is a definite upgrade over the previous audience version [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-12-14.all.sbd.minches.108813.flac1644**: transferred by David Minches; source: Unknown generation cassette from sound board master Transfer and FLAC encoding by David Minches: Cassette played back on Nakamichi Dragon> Korg MR-1000(DSF… [1]. Also: Matt Kelley on harmonica; Airto & Flora Purim on Drums/Space [1]
- **gd1980-12-14.175909.nak700.ellner.menke.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Ron Ellner; transferred by Bob Menke, Charlie Miller, Scott Clugston; source: Ron Ellner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5 (Maxell XLII-S90) provides "Bertha" through "Passenger", "Cold Rain & Snow > Samson &… [3]. Also: Charlie Miller coordinated the effort for the transfer [3]
- **gd1980-12-14.nak300.walker-scotton.miller.89058.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 300 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M/Maxell UDXL-II90) [5]. Also: Recorded by Walker-Scotton and processed by Charlie; Kudos to Joani Walker and Charlie Miller for the articulate mix; Recorded by Joani Walker near the SBD area; tapes from Scotton [5][9][17]
- **gd1980-12-14.nak700.miller.89003.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master (Sony D5M) -> Dat [7]
